verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator with a supporting software stack (ROCm, SMI, schedulers). It has no user-facing interface where a built-in assistant could take delegated tasks, so this story is a category error for the product type. The 'AI-native job scheduler' Spur is a Slurm-compatible scheduler, not an AI assistant, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
